signal: Connected2Fiber rebranded to Connectbase and expanded its ecosystem with Virgin Media Business Wholesale and a Converge collaboration in Southeast Asia

email.body1:
Carrie, saw Connectbase rebrand and expand the ecosystem with Virgin Media Business Wholesale and the Converge collaboration in Southeast Asia.

Adding networks and regions that fast usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before they go cold, especially across new geographies. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Connectbase off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress around 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Carrie, quick follow-up for Connectbase.

With the ecosystem growing across regions, the addressable list outpaces rep capacity, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit target. The gap shows up late, and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Connectbase needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Carrie, last bit of proof for Connectbase.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Connectbase's reply rate likely compares to peer connectivity platforms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Carrie, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters right after a rebrand and expansion, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a connectivity-platform motion? I will tailor it to Connectbase either way.
